lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Ensure adequate pre-sowing irrigation (Paleva/Rauni) to create a moist seedbed.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Treat seeds with bio-fertilizers (Azotobacter & PSB cultures @ 20g/kg seed). No direct chemical fertilizer on seeds.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Check for broken, shrivelled seeds and loose smut infection history.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Use certified seed tags (e.g., HD 3086, DBW 187, DBW 222). Do not mix chemical fungicide directly with bio-fertilizer cultures simultaneously.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 2. खेत की तैयारी एवं मृदा स्वास्थ्य
lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Plough at optimal soil moisture tilth (neither too dry nor waterlogged).
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Apply well-decomposed FYM @ 10-15 tonnes/ha during initial ploughing. Apply full Basal P2O5 and K2O based on Soil Health Card.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Inspect for termites and white grub larvae in field corners.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Avoid unrotted fresh cattle manure to prevent termite flare-up.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Sow when soil moisture line is at 4-5 cm depth.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Drill basal fertilizer 2-3 cm below the seed line using a Seed-cum-Fertilizer drill.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Protect surface seeds from bird picking and rodent burrows.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Maintain 20-22.5 cm row spacing. Sowing deeper than 5 cm causes delayed and uneven emergence.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: No irrigation required if pre-sowing moisture was adequate.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: No top-dressing fertilizer required at seedling emergence.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for cutworms clipping tender young shoots at soil level.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Avoid standing water in low-lying field patches.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 5. वानस्पतिक वृद्धि / कल्ले फूटने की अवस्था (CRI)
lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: First and most critical irrigation at Crown Root Initiation (CRI) 20-25 days after sowing (DAS).
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Apply 1st top-dressing of Nitrogen (Urea) immediately after 1st irrigation as per STCR recommendation.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout lower canopy leaves for yellow rust (stripe rust) pustules and broadleaf weeds (Phalaris minor / Bathua).
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Moisture stress at CRI causes irreversible tillering reduction.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 6. फूल आना / बाली निकलना (बूट व हेडिंग अवस्था)
lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Critical irrigation at late jointing/booting stage (50-60 DAS) to maintain uniform spikelet development.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Apply 2nd top-dressing of Nitrogen (if recommended by regional split) prior to panicle emergence.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Monitor for powdery mildew, leaf blight, and foliar aphids.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Avoid foliar spraying during morning peak pollination window.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_en: Fruiting / Grain Filling (Milk to Soft Dough)
lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 7. दाना भराव अवस्था (दूधिया से दाना सख्त होना)
lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Irrigate at milk and soft dough stage on calm days to prevent lodging.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Optional foliar spray of Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45) @ 1% during dry terminal heat spells.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for earhead caterpillars and late black/brown rust symptoms.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Never irrigate during high winds (>18 km/h) to prevent crop lodging.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Strictly stop all irrigation 10-15 days prior to harvest.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Allow uniform field drying for combine harvester entry.

lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Stubble management: Spray Pusa Bio-decomposer on crop residue instead of burning.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Inspect harvested grain samples for broken kernels or kernel bunt.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Do not burn crop residue. Harvest when grain moisture is below 15%.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 10. कटाई उपरांत प्रबंधन एवं सुरक्षित भंडारण
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout storage bins for Khapra beetle (Trogoderma granarium) and rice weevil.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Sun-dry grain to <= 12% moisture before hermetic or metal bin storage.
